title: Finish & Harden Existing AI Software
problem: For AI-assisted apps that mostly work but still have architecture, state-integrity, security, testing, or deployment gaps.
entry: Repository audit + fix the highest-priority blocker + verified build/test state + exact remaining blockers.

title: Build AI Automations & Internal Tools
problem: For teams that need a bounded AI workflow inside a real application or operational process—not a standalone prompt demo.
entry: One end-to-end vertical slice with structured inputs/outputs, failure behavior, and a human-control boundary.

title: Build Research, Extraction & Decision Pipelines
problem: For repeated research/data work that needs collection, normalization, deduplication, provenance, ranking, and reliable export.
entry: One representative source integrated end-to-end through validation, dedupe, provenance, and deterministic output.
proof: Market Intelligence Pipeline, SignalOps, GitHub Issue Mining
